---
title: "Debugging: core/border/stroma compartment analysis"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  workflowr::wflow_html
editor_options:
  chunk_output_type: inline
params:
  input: !r Sys.getenv("MAPMET_INPUT", "/mnt/data/input_all")
  output: !r Sys.getenv("MAPMET_OUTPUT", "/mnt/data/output")
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Plots / tables directories (kept separate from 07_spatial_analysis outputs).
# Both are split into the same subfolders: samples, proportions, cell_counts,
# areas, densities, threshold_check.
plot_dir  <- file.path(params$output, "plots/07.1_debugging")
table_dir <- file.path(params$output, "tables/07.1_debugging")

# Date prefix for filenames
date_prefix <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")

# Full output path in a subfolder of base_dir (created if needed)
output_path <- function(base_dir, subdir, filename) {
  out_dir <- file.path(base_dir, subdir)
  if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  file.path(out_dir, paste0(date_prefix, "_", filename))
}

# Save a plot (ggplot / patchwork) into a subfolder of plot_dir
save_plot <- function(plot_obj, filename, subdir, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300) {
  full_path <- output_path(plot_dir, subdir, filename)
  ggsave(full_path, plot = plot_obj, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi)
  message("Saved: ", full_path)
}

# Save a table as csv into a subfolder of table_dir
save_table <- function(df, filename, subdir) {
  full_path <- output_path(table_dir, subdir, filename)
  write.csv(df, full_path, row.names = FALSE)
  message("Saved: ", full_path)
}

# Global chunk options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  error = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  dev = "png",
  dpi = 300,
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 6
)
```

# Debugging the core/border/stroma analysis

This file only reproduces the compartment (core / border / stroma) analysis and
its `diffcyt` statistics from [07_spatial_analysis](07_spatial_analysis.html),
starting from the `spe_07_spatial_analysis.rds` checkpoint, so that none of the
long-running steps of 07 (neighbors, interaction testing, CN clustering, patch
detection, distances) have to be rerun. It contains

* paired boxplots of the proportions (point size = number of cells, lines
  connecting the same sample), with the `diffcyt` statistics of 07,
* tables and plots of the number of cells per sample and compartment,
* compartment areas per image (from the tumor-patch outlines) and densities
  (cells / mm²) per compartment, with a paired negative-binomial test,
* a threshold check: the immune tests rerun with a minimum number of cells per
  sample and compartment.

## Read data

The checkpoint saved at the end of 07 already carries the canonical compartment
assignment (`compartment`, border = 200 px), the cellular neighborhoods
(`cn_celltypes_2`) and `celltype_2`.

```{r read-data}
# Structural colors (COL_COMPARTMENT, COL_CN) from 00_MapMet_color_code.R
for (mapmet_cc_path in c("analysis/00_MapMet_color_code.R", "00_MapMet_color_code.R", "../analysis/00_MapMet_color_code.R"))
  if (file.exists(mapmet_cc_path)) { source(mapmet_cc_path); break }

spe <- readRDS(file.path(params$output, "spe_07_spatial_analysis.rds"))

required_cols <- c("compartment", "celltype_2", "metacluster", "cn_celltypes_2",
                   "fm_id", "sample", "sample_id", "patient_id")
missing_cols  <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(colData(spe)))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0)
  stop("spe_07_spatial_analysis.rds lacks: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))

table(spe$compartment, useNA = "ifany")
```

## Samples, images and patients

The compartment statistics pool all images of a sample (`fm_id`), while the
`diffcyt` design uses the `sample` column (image name without the image number,
which also carries the acquisition date). Both should map one-to-one; samples
where they do not are listed below.

```{r sample-overview}
cell_df <- data.frame(
  patient_id  = spe$patient_id,
  fm_id       = spe$fm_id,
  sample      = spe$sample,
  sample_id   = spe$sample_id,
  compartment = spe$compartment,
  metacluster = spe$metacluster
)

sample_overview <- cell_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(patient_id, fm_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_images  = dplyr::n_distinct(sample_id),
                   n_sample  = dplyr::n_distinct(sample),
                   n_cells   = dplyr::n(),
                   .groups   = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(patient_id, fm_id)

save_table(sample_overview, "sample_overview.csv", "samples")
knitr::kable(sample_overview)

# fm_ids whose images carry several `sample` values (would break the diffcyt pairing)
sample_overview %>% dplyr::filter(n_sample > 1)

# patients with more than one PT sample
sample_overview %>% dplyr::count(patient_id) %>% dplyr::filter(n > 1)
```

## Cluster definitions

Copied from 07: marker classes and cluster orders/colors.

```{r define-markers}

# Define cell_type_markers
type_markers <- c("MPO_Y89_mean", "CD44_In115_mean", "CD11b_Nd142_mean", "HLA-DR_Nd143_mean", "PRPH_Nd144_mean", "HLA-ABC_Sm147_mean", "CD20_Nd148_mean", "LUM_Sm149_mean", "CD11c_Nd150_mean",
                  "CD24_Eu151_mean", "CD3_Sm152_mean", "CD45_Eu153_mean", "CD8a_Sm154_mean", "GD2_Gd155_mean", "CD34_Gd156_mean", "CD10_Gd158_mean", "CXCR4_Tb159_mean","SOX10_Dy162_mean",
                  "FOXP3_Dy163_mean", "CHGA_Dy164_mean", "GATA3_Er168_mean", "CD56_Er170_mean", "CD4_Yb171_mean", "ELAVL4_Yb174_mean", "CD14_Lu175_mean", "Vimentin_Pt196_mean", "CD15_Bi209_mean")

# Define cell_state_markers
state_markers <- c("CD274_Gd160_mean", "S100B_Dy161_mean", "CD279_Ho165_mean", "Ki-67_Tm169_mean", "GZMB_Yb173_mean")

```

```{r cluster-order-colors}
immune_order <- c("T cells", "B cells", "myeloid/NK", "granulocytes")

tumor_order <- c("adrenergic marker-low Tu", "GD2neg Tu", "CD44+ Tu", "Ki67+ Tu",
                 "neuroblast-like Tu", "early neuroblast-like Tu")
# keep only the celltypes actually present in the data (preserves order)
tumor_order <- intersect(tumor_order,
                         unique(as.character(spe$celltype_2[spe$metacluster == "tumor"])))

neighborhood_order <- levels(factor(spe$cn_celltypes_2))

# Color lookup, falling back to grey if a cluster has no (or NA) color. Looks
# up col_celltype_2 by default; pass color_vec = col_cn for neighborhoods.
cluster_color <- function(name, color_vec = metadata(spe)$color_vectors$col_celltype_2) {
  col <- unname(color_vec[as.character(name)])
  if (length(col) == 0 || is.na(col)) "grey50" else col
}

cells_list       <- c("tumor", "immune", "neighborhood")
comp_levels      <- c("core", "border", "stroma")
comparison_pairs <- list(c("core","border"), c("core","stroma"), c("border","stroma"))

# Cells, cluster column, display order and colors of each cell class: celltype_2
# for tumor/immune; cn_celltypes_2 for neighborhoods, so every cell counts.
class_definition <- function(cells) {
  list(
    order         = switch(cells,
                           immune       = immune_order,
                           tumor        = tumor_order,
                           neighborhood = neighborhood_order),
    keep          = switch(cells,
                           immune       = spe$metacluster %in% immune_order,
                           tumor        = spe$metacluster == "tumor",
                           neighborhood = rep(TRUE, ncol(spe))),
    cluster_field = if (cells == "neighborhood") "cn_celltypes_2" else "celltype_2",
    color_vec     = if (cells == "neighborhood") metadata(spe)$color_vectors$col_cn else
                                                 metadata(spe)$color_vectors$col_celltype_2
  )
}
```

## Differential abundance between compartments

Same `diffcyt` (`testDA_edgeR`) analysis as in 07, for every compartment pair,
with sample-level pairing. `min_total` (default 0, i.e. as in 07) is only used
for the threshold check below: it keeps, per pair, only samples with at least
`min_total` cells of the class in both compartments.

```{r compartment-da}
keep_rows <- rowData(spe)$use_channel

# helper to build marker_info from the global marker vectors
.make_marker_info <- function(spe, keep_rows) {
  channel_name <- sapply(strsplit(rownames(rowData(spe)[keep_rows, ]), "_"), "[[", 2)
  marker_name  <- sapply(strsplit(rownames(rowData(spe)[keep_rows, ]), "_"), "[[", 1)
  marker_class <- ifelse(rownames(rowData(spe)[keep_rows, ]) %in% type_markers, "type",
                  ifelse(rownames(rowData(spe)[keep_rows, ]) %in% state_markers, "state", "other"))
  data.frame(channel_name, marker_name,
             marker_class = factor(marker_class),
             row.names = marker_name)
}

marker_info_da <- .make_marker_info(spe, keep_rows)

run_compartment_da <- function(cells, min_total = 0) {
  def           <- class_definition(cells)
  order         <- def$order
  keep_meta     <- def$keep
  cluster_field <- def$cluster_field

  # 1. diffcyt DA results for every compartment pair
  diffcyt_results <- list()
  n_samples       <- list()

  for (pair in comparison_pairs) {
    comps     <- pair
    key       <- paste(comps, collapse = "-")
    keep_cols <- keep_meta & spe$compartment %in% comps

    # threshold check only: samples with >= min_total cells in both compartments
    pair_totals <- table(spe$fm_id[keep_cols],
                         factor(spe$compartment[keep_cols], levels = comps))
    if (min_total > 0) {
      kept_samples <- rownames(pair_totals)[apply(pair_totals >= min_total, 1, all)]
      keep_cols    <- keep_cols & spe$fm_id %in% kept_samples
    }
    # samples with cells in both compartments (the ones informative for the pairing)
    n_samples[[key]] <- sum(apply(pair_totals >= max(min_total, 1), 1, all))

    # too few cells, or (after the threshold) too few samples / compartments
    # left for the paired design
    if (sum(keep_cols) < 10 ||
        length(unique(spe$fm_id[keep_cols])) < 2 ||
        length(unique(spe$compartment[keep_cols])) < 2) { diffcyt_results[[key]] <- NULL; next }

    sce_da <- SingleCellExperiment(
      assays = list(
        counts = assay(spe, "counts")[keep_rows, keep_cols],
        exprs  = assay(spe, "counts")[keep_rows, keep_cols]
      )
    )
    sce_da$fm_id       <- spe[keep_rows, keep_cols]$fm_id
    sce_da$sample      <- factor(spe[keep_rows, keep_cols]$sample)
    sce_da$compartment <- factor(spe[keep_rows, keep_cols]$compartment, levels = comps)
    sce_da$sample_id   <- factor(paste0(sce_da$fm_id, "_", sce_da$compartment))
    sce_da$condition   <- factor(sce_da$compartment, levels = comps)
    sce_da$cluster_id  <- factor(spe[keep_rows, keep_cols][[cluster_field]], levels = order)

    metadata(sce_da)$cluster_codes   <- data.frame(
      celltype = factor(spe[keep_rows, keep_cols][[cluster_field]], levels = order)
    )
    metadata(sce_da)$experiment_info <- as.data.frame(colData(sce_da)) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(sample_id, condition, sample) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(n_cells = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
      as.data.frame()

    exp_info           <- metadata(sce_da)$experiment_info
    exp_info           <- exp_info[match(unique(sce_da$sample_id), exp_info$sample_id), ]
    exp_info$condition <- factor(exp_info$condition, levels = comps)

    df_list_da <- lapply(unique(sce_da$sample_id), function(x)
      as.data.frame(t(counts(sce_da[, sce_da$sample_id == x]))))
    names(df_list_da) <- unique(sce_da$sample_id)

    d_se_da <- prepareData(df_list_da, exp_info, marker_info_da)
    rowData(d_se_da)$cluster_id     <- sce_da[, rownames(d_se_da)]$cluster_id
    metadata(d_se_da)$cluster_codes <- metadata(sce_da)$cluster_codes
    d_se_da     <- transformData(d_se_da)
    d_counts_da <- calcCounts(d_se_da)

    design_da   <- createDesignMatrix(exp_info, cols_design = c("condition", "sample"))
    contrast_da <- createContrast(c(0, 1, rep(0, length(unique(exp_info$sample)) - 1)))

    res_DA_da <- tryCatch(
      testDA_edgeR(d_counts_da, design_da, contrast_da,
                   min_cells = 3,
                   min_samples = round(ncol(d_counts_da) * 0.2)),
      error = function(e) { message("diffcyt failed for ", key, ": ", e$message); NULL }
    )
    diffcyt_results[[key]] <- if (!is.null(res_DA_da)) data.frame(rowData(res_DA_da)) else NULL
  }

  # 2. Sample-level proportions (% within compartment) for plotting
  comp_df <- data.frame(
    fm_id       = spe$fm_id,
    compartment = spe$compartment,
    cluster_id  = spe[[cluster_field]],
    keep        = keep_meta
  )
  comp_df <- comp_df[comp_df$keep & comp_df$compartment %in% comp_levels, ]
  comp_df$compartment <- factor(comp_df$compartment, levels = comp_levels)

  sample_totals <- comp_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(fm_id, compartment) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(total = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")

  plot_data_list <- list()
  for (cluster_name in order) {
    cluster_counts <- comp_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(cluster_id == cluster_name) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(fm_id, compartment) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")

    plot_data_list[[cluster_name]] <- dplyr::left_join(
      sample_totals, cluster_counts, by = c("fm_id", "compartment")
    ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        n         = dplyr::if_else(is.na(n), 0L, n),
        Freq      = 100 * n / total,
        condition = factor(compartment, levels = comp_levels),
        sample_id = fm_id
      )
  }

  # 3. Collate diffcyt stats for all pairs into one table
  all_stats_list <- list()
  for (cluster_name in order) {
    for (pair in comparison_pairs) {
      key      <- paste(pair, collapse = "-")
      res_pair <- diffcyt_results[[key]]
      if (!is.null(res_pair) && cluster_name %in% rownames(res_pair)) {
        p_adj <- res_pair[cluster_name, "p_adj"]
        logFC <- res_pair[cluster_name, "logFC"]
      } else {
        p_adj <- NA_real_; logFC <- NA_real_
      }
      p_signif <- if (!is.na(p_adj)) gtools::stars.pval(p_adj) else "NA"
      if (p_signif == " ") p_signif <- "ns"
      all_stats_list <- c(all_stats_list, list(data.frame(
        cluster_name = cluster_name,
        group1       = pair[1],
        group2       = pair[2],
        n_samples    = n_samples[[key]],
        p_adj        = p_adj,
        logFC        = round(logFC, 2),
        label        = paste0(round(logFC, 2), " (",
                              if (!is.na(p_adj)) sprintf("%.3f", p_adj) else "NA",
                              " ", p_signif, ")")
      )))
    }
  }

  list(order          = order,
       color_vec      = def$color_vec,
       plot_data_list = plot_data_list,
       all_stats      = dplyr::bind_rows(all_stats_list))
}

da_results <- lapply(setNames(cells_list, cells_list), run_compartment_da)

for (cells in cells_list) {
  save_table(da_results[[cells]]$all_stats, paste0("compartment_DA_stats_", cells, ".csv"), "proportions")
  print(knitr::kable(da_results[[cells]]$all_stats, caption = cells))
}
```

## Paired boxplots: point size = number of cells, lines = same sample

Same data and statistics as the Fig4m boxplots of 07, but each point is sized by the number of cells of
the class in that sample and compartment (the denominator of the proportion),
and the points of one sample are connected across core / border / stroma.

```{r compartment-boxplots-paired}
# Freq is a percentage: panels use a fixed 0-100 y-axis with the pairwise
# brackets drawn above it (clip = "off").
y_axis_max        <- 100
bracket_base      <- 106
bracket_gap       <- 14
title_gap         <- 85
bracket_positions <- bracket_base + (seq_along(comparison_pairs) - 1) * bracket_gap
max_plot_columns  <- 5

plot_compartment_paired <- function(proportions, stats_df, cluster_name,
                                    color_cluster, size_limits, y_label) {
  ggplot(proportions, aes(x = condition, y = Freq)) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = color_cluster, color = "black", outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6) +
    geom_line(aes(group = sample_id), color = "grey40", alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(aes(size = total), color = "black") +
    stat_pvalue_manual(stats_df, y.position = "y.position", label = "label") +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = comp_levels) +
    scale_size_area(max_size = 5, limits = size_limits, name = "cells in\ncompartment") +
    ggtitle(str_wrap(cluster_name, width = 18)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_label) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, y_axis_max, 25),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0))) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_axis_max), clip = "off") +
    theme_pubr() +
    theme(aspect.ratio = 1.0, legend.position = "right",
          plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14,
                                     margin = margin(b = title_gap)),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 8, b = 8, l = 8))
}

for (cells in cells_list) {
  res <- da_results[[cells]]

  # one shared size scale per cell class, so the legends collapse into one
  size_limits <- c(0, max(sapply(res$plot_data_list, function(d) max(d$total))))
  y_label     <- if (cells == "neighborhood") "% of all cells" else paste0("% of ", cells, " cells")

  plot_list_paired <- list()
  for (cluster_name in res$order) {
    stats_df            <- res$all_stats[res$all_stats$cluster_name == cluster_name, ]
    stats_df$y.position <- bracket_positions[seq_len(nrow(stats_df))]

    plot_list_paired[[cluster_name]] <- plot_compartment_paired(
      res$plot_data_list[[cluster_name]], stats_df, cluster_name,
      cluster_color(cluster_name, res$color_vec), size_limits, y_label
    )
  }

  n_cols   <- min(length(plot_list_paired), max_plot_columns)
  p_paired <- wrap_plots(plot_list_paired, ncol = n_cols) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect")

  save_plot(p_paired,
            paste0("Fig4m_boxplot_compartments_paired_", cells, ".pdf"), "proportions",
            width = 3 * n_cols + 2,
            height = 4.5 * ceiling(length(plot_list_paired) / n_cols))
  print(p_paired)
}
```

## Number of cells per sample and compartment

Cell counts per sample (`fm_id`) and compartment, per cluster and as totals
per cell class (the denominators of the proportions above). Zero counts are
kept explicitly (e.g. samples without a core).

```{r cell-counts}
count_thresholds <- c(10, 20, 50, 100)

patient_lookup <- dplyr::distinct(cell_df, fm_id, patient_id)
sample_levels  <- sort(unique(cell_df$fm_id))

count_cells <- function(cells) {
  def <- class_definition(cells)
  data.frame(
    fm_id       = factor(spe$fm_id, levels = sample_levels),
    compartment = factor(spe$compartment, levels = comp_levels),
    cluster_id  = factor(spe[[def$cluster_field]], levels = def$order)
  )[def$keep, ] %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(compartment), !is.na(cluster_id)) %>%
    dplyr::count(fm_id, compartment, cluster_id, name = "n", .drop = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cells = cells)
}

counts_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(cells_list, count_cells)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(fm_id = as.character(fm_id)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(patient_lookup, by = "fm_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cells = factor(cells, levels = cells_list))

totals <- counts_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cells, patient_id, fm_id, compartment) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(total = sum(n), .groups = "drop")

# totals per sample: one column per cell class x compartment
totals_wide <- totals %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = c(cells, compartment), values_from = total) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(patient_id, fm_id)
save_table(totals_wide, "cell_counts_per_sample_compartment_totals.csv", "cell_counts")
knitr::kable(totals_wide)

# per cluster: one table per cell class, one column per cluster
for (cells in cells_list) {
  cluster_wide <- counts_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(cells == !!cells) %>%
    dplyr::select(-cells) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = cluster_id, values_from = n) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(patient_id, fm_id, compartment)
  save_table(cluster_wide, paste0("cell_counts_per_sample_compartment_", cells, ".csv"), "cell_counts")
  print(knitr::kable(cluster_wide, caption = cells))
}

# per image (for a possible image-level analysis)
image_counts <- cell_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(compartment %in% comp_levels) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cells = dplyr::case_when(metacluster == "tumor"         ~ "tumor",
                                         metacluster %in% immune_order  ~ "immune",
                                         TRUE                           ~ "other")) %>%
  dplyr::count(patient_id, fm_id, sample_id, compartment, cells, name = "n") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = c(cells, compartment), values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(patient_id, fm_id, sample_id)
save_table(image_counts, "cell_counts_per_image_compartment.csv", "cell_counts")
```

How many samples would be kept at a given minimum number of cells: per
compartment, and per compartment pair (a sample enters a paired comparison only
if both compartments reach the threshold).

```{r cell-count-thresholds}
samples_per_compartment <- totals %>%
  tidyr::crossing(min_cells = count_thresholds) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cells, min_cells, compartment) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_samples = sum(total >= min_cells), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = compartment, values_from = n_samples)

samples_per_pair <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(comparison_pairs, function(pair) {
  totals %>%
    dplyr::filter(compartment %in% pair) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cells, fm_id) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(min_total = min(total), .groups = "drop") %>%
    tidyr::crossing(min_cells = count_thresholds) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cells, min_cells) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_samples = sum(min_total >= min_cells), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(pair = paste(pair, collapse = "-"))
})) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = pair, values_from = n_samples)

samples_kept <- dplyr::left_join(samples_per_compartment, samples_per_pair,
                                 by = c("cells", "min_cells"))
save_table(samples_kept, "samples_kept_per_min_cells.csv", "cell_counts")
knitr::kable(samples_kept, caption = paste0("Samples with at least min_cells cells (of ",
                                            length(sample_levels), " samples)"))
```

```{r cell-count-plots, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
totals$sample_label <- paste0(totals$patient_id, " (", totals$fm_id, ")")
counts_long$sample_label <- paste0(counts_long$patient_id, " (", counts_long$fm_id, ")")
class_labels <- c(tumor = "tumor cells", immune = "immune cells", neighborhood = "all cells (CN)")
n_samples    <- length(sample_levels)

# 1. totals per sample x compartment, per cell class
p_totals <- ggplot(totals, aes(x = compartment, y = sample_label, fill = log10(total + 1))) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
```

## Compartment areas

To turn counts into densities (cells per mm²), we need the area of each
compartment per image. We use the tumor-patch outlines:

* each patch outline is the concave hull of all cells carrying its `patch_id`,
  built as in `imcRtools::patchSize` / `patchDetection`
  (`concaveman(..., concavity = 1)`);
* core = patch outlines grown by 200 px, minus everything within 200 px of a
  non-patch cell (the rule 07 applies to patch cells: distance to the nearest
  non-patch cell > 200 px). Image edges therefore do not create a border, and
  the strip between a patch outline and the image edge stays core;
* border = patch outlines grown by 200 px, minus the core; stroma = the rest of
  the image;
* there is no tissue mask, so the image (ROI) is taken as fully covered by
  tissue; its extent is the bounding box of the cell centres (1 px = 1 µm).

The cells' compartments in 07 come from cell-to-cell distances
(`minDistToCells`), not from the outlines, so we check per image how many cells
fall into the polygon of their own compartment.

```{r compartment-area-params}
border_size     <- 200    # canonical border of 07 (canonical_border)
no_patch_images <- "20221018_20220906_03-018_TU_001"   # all stroma in 07
example_images  <- c("20220926_20220809_16-006_TU_003",
                     "20220925_20220804_17-001_TU_002")
```

```{r compartment-areas}
# Concave hull of a patch, as imcRtools .polygon_function (NULL for <= 2 cells)
patch_polygon <- function(xy) {
  if (nrow(xy) <= 2) return(NULL)
  st_polygon(list(concaveman(xy, concavity = 1)))
}

# Assign points to the compartment polygons
classify_by_polygon <- function(points, regions) {
  comp <- rep("stroma", nrow(points))
  pts  <- st_cast(st_sfc(st_multipoint(points)), "POINT")
  comp[lengths(st_intersects(pts, regions$border)) > 0] <- "border"
  comp[lengths(st_intersects(pts, regions$core))   > 0] <- "core"
  comp
}

cell_coords <- spatialCoords(spe)[, c("Pos_X", "Pos_Y")]

area_results <- lapply(unique(spe$sample_id), function(img) {
  sel      <- spe$sample_id == img
  cell_xy  <- cell_coords[sel, , drop = FALSE]
  patch_id <- if (img %in% no_patch_images) rep(NA, sum(sel)) else spe$patch_id[sel]

  # image extent = bounding box of the cell centres
  x_range <- range(cell_xy[, 1])
  y_range <- range(cell_xy[, 2])
  roi <- st_sfc(st_polygon(list(rbind(c(x_range[1], y_range[1]), c(x_range[2], y_range[1]),
                                      c(x_range[2], y_range[2]), c(x_range[1], y_range[2]),
                                      c(x_range[1], y_range[1])))))

  polygons <- Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(unique(na.omit(patch_id)), function(p)
    patch_polygon(cell_xy[which(patch_id == p), , drop = FALSE])))

  empty <- st_sfc(st_polygon())
  if (length(polygons) == 0) {
    regions <- list(core = empty, border = empty, stroma = roi)
  } else {
    patches <- st_intersection(st_union(st_make_valid(st_sfc(polygons))), roi)

    outer <- st_intersection(st_buffer(patches, border_size), roi)

    # core: within border_size of a patch, but further than border_size from any
    # non-patch cell (only non-patch cells within 2 x border_size of a patch can
    # cut into it)
    non_patch <- st_cast(st_sfc(st_multipoint(cell_xy[is.na(patch_id), , drop = FALSE])), "POINT")
    non_patch <- non_patch[lengths(st_is_within_distance(non_patch, patches, 2 * border_size)) > 0]
    core <- if (length(non_patch) == 0) outer else
      st_difference(outer, st_union(st_buffer(non_patch, border_size, nQuadSegs = 8)))
    regions <- list(core   = core,
                    border = st_difference(outer, core),
                    stroma = st_difference(roi, outer))
    regions <- lapply(regions, function(g) if (length(g) == 0) empty else g)
  }

  cell_comp <- classify_by_polygon(cell_xy, regions)

  list(
    areas     = data.frame(sample_id   = img,
                           compartment = comp_levels,
                           area_mm2    = sapply(regions[comp_levels], function(g) sum(st_area(g))) / 1e6),
    roi       = data.frame(sample_id = img,
                           width_px  = diff(x_range),
                           height_px = diff(y_range),
                           n_patches = length(polygons)),
    agreement = data.frame(sample_id = img,
                           n_cells   = sum(sel),
                           agreement = mean(cell_comp == spe$compartment[sel])),
    confusion = data.frame(sample_id = img,
                           cell_rule = spe$compartment[sel],
                           polygon   = cell_comp) %>%
                  dplyr::count(sample_id, cell_rule, polygon),
    example   = if (img %in% example_images) regions
  )
})

# 1. image extents (check against the expected image size)
```

## Densities per compartment

Cells per mm² of compartment, per sample (all images summed). For each cluster
and compartment pair, densities are compared with a negative-binomial GLM on
the counts with the compartment area as offset and the sample as a fixed effect
(the same paired design as the `diffcyt` test, `~ condition + sample`), fitted
per cluster with `MASS::glm.nb`. Samples with an empty compartment (area 0) or
with no cells of the cluster in either compartment are left out of that test.
The log2 fold change is the second compartment of the pair vs. the first (as
in `diffcyt`), and p-values are BH-adjusted across clusters within each cell
class and compartment pair.

```{r densities}
density_df <- counts_long %>%
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of("sample_label")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(dplyr::select(areas_sample, fm_id, compartment, area_mm2),
                   by = c("fm_id", "compartment")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(area_mm2 = dplyr::coalesce(area_mm2, 0),
                density  = dplyr::if_else(area_mm2 > 0, n / area_mm2, NA_real_)) %>%
  # cells of the class per sample and compartment (for the threshold check)
  dplyr::group_by(cells, fm_id, compartment) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(total = sum(n)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

for (cells in cells_list) {
  save_table(density_df %>%
               dplyr::filter(cells == !!cells) %>%
               dplyr::select(patient_id, fm_id, compartment, area_mm2, cluster_id, density) %>%
               tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = cluster_id, values_from = density) %>%
               dplyr::arrange(patient_id, fm_id, compartment),
             paste0("density_per_sample_compartment_", cells, ".csv"), "densities")
}

# NB GLM for one cluster and compartment pair; min_total (threshold check only)
# keeps samples with >= min_total cells of the class in both compartments
test_density_pair <- function(df, pair, min_total = 0) {
  d <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(compartment %in% pair, area_mm2 > 0) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(fm_id) %>%
    dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() == 2, sum(n) > 0, all(total >= min_total)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(compartment = factor(as.character(compartment), levels = pair),
                  fm_id       = factor(fm_id))

  if (dplyr::n_distinct(d$fm_id) < 3) return(data.frame(n_samples = dplyr::n_distinct(d$fm_id), logFC = NA_real_, p_val = NA_real_))

  fit <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(MASS::glm.nb(n ~ compartment + fm_id + offset(log(area_mm2)), data = d)),
    error = function(e) { message("glm.nb failed: ", e$message); NULL }
  )
  if (is.null(fit)) return(data.frame(n_samples = dplyr::n_distinct(d$fm_id), logFC = NA_real_, p_val = NA_real_))

  coefs    <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  coef_row <- if (paste0("compartment", pair[2]) %in% rownames(coefs))
                coefs[paste0("compartment", pair[2]), ] else
                c(Estimate = NA_real_, `Pr(>|z|)` = NA_real_)
  data.frame(n_samples = dplyr::n_distinct(d$fm_id),
             logFC     = unname(coef_row["Estimate"]) / log(2),
             p_val     = unname(coef_row["Pr(>|z|)"]))
}

# All clusters of a cell class, all compartment pairs (BH within class x pair)
density_tests <- function(cells, min_total = 0) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(comparison_pairs, function(pair) {
    res <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(class_definition(cells)$order, function(cluster_name) {
      cluster_df <- dplyr::filter(density_df, cells == !!cells, cluster_id == cluster_name)
      data.frame(cluster_name = cluster_name, test_density_pair(cluster_df, pair, min_total))
    }))
    res$p_adj  <- p.adjust(res$p_val, method = "BH")
    res$cells  <- cells
    res$group1 <- pair[1]
    res$group2 <- pair[2]
    res
  }))
}

density_stats <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(cells_list, density_tests)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_signif = dplyr::if_else(is.na(p_adj), "NA", trimws(gtools::stars.pval(p_adj))),
    p_signif = dplyr::if_else(p_signif == "", "ns", p_signif),
    label    = paste0(round(logFC, 2), " (",
                      dplyr::if_else(is.na(p_adj), "NA", sprintf("%.3f", p_adj)),
                      " ", p_signif, ")")
  )

save_table(density_stats, "density_compartment_stats.csv", "densities")
knitr::kable(density_stats %>% dplyr::select(cells, cluster_name, group1, group2, n_samples, logFC, p_adj, label),
             digits = 3)
```

Paired density boxplots, as above: one line per sample, point size = area of
the compartment (the denominator of the density).

```{r density-boxplots}
plot_density_paired <- function(dens, stats_df, cluster_name, color_cluster, size_limits) {
  dens <- dplyr::filter(dens, !is.na(density))

  y_top <- max(dens$density, 1)
  stats_df$y.position <- y_top * (1.08 + 0.14 * (seq_len(nrow(stats_df)) - 1))

  ggplot(dens, aes(x = compartment, y = density)) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = color_cluster, color = "black", outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6) +
    geom_line(aes(group = fm_id), color = "grey40", alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(aes(size = area_mm2), color = "black") +
    stat_pvalue_manual(stats_df, y.position = "y.position", label = "label") +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = comp_levels) +
    scale_size_area(max_size = 5, limits = size_limits,
                    name = expression(atop("compartment", "area (mm"^2*")"))) +
    # headroom for the bracket labels above the top bracket
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.12))) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    ggtitle(str_wrap(cluster_name, width = 18)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = expression("cells / mm"^2)) +
    theme_pubr() +
    theme(aspect.ratio = 1.0, legend.position = "right",
          plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, margin = margin(b = 12)),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 8, b = 8, l = 8))
}

size_limits_area <- c(0, max(areas_sample$area_mm2))

for (cells in cells_list) {
  def <- class_definition(cells)

  plot_list_density <- list()
  for (cluster_name in def$order) {
    plot_list_density[[cluster_name]] <- plot_density_paired(
      dplyr::filter(density_df, cells == !!cells, cluster_id == cluster_name),
      dplyr::filter(density_stats, cells == !!cells, cluster_name == !!cluster_name),
      cluster_name, cluster_color(cluster_name, def$color_vec), size_limits_area
    )
  }

  n_cols    <- min(length(plot_list_density), max_plot_columns)
  p_density <- wrap_plots(plot_list_density, ncol = n_cols) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect")

  save_plot(p_density,
            paste0("Fig4m_density_compartments_paired_", cells, ".pdf"), "densities",
            width = 3 * n_cols + 2,
            height = 4 * ceiling(length(plot_list_density) / n_cols))
  print(p_density)
}
```

## Threshold check (immune cells)

Immune cells are scarce in the core of several samples, so we rerun the immune
tests (proportions with `diffcyt`, densities with `glm.nb`) keeping, per
compartment pair, only samples with at least 20 or 50 immune cells in both
compartments. The unfiltered tests above stay the main result; this only shows
whether a call depends on the low-count samples. A call is "up" / "down" (higher
/ lower in the second compartment of the pair, adjusted p < 0.05) or "ns".

```{r threshold-check}
threshold_check_classes   <- "immune"
threshold_check_min_cells <- c(20, 50)
alpha_check               <- 0.05

check_columns <- c("test", "cells", "cluster_name", "group1", "group2",
                   "min_cells", "n_samples", "logFC", "p_adj")

check_diffcyt <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(threshold_check_classes, function(cells) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(c(0, threshold_check_min_cells), function(m) {
    stats <- if (m == 0) da_results[[cells]]$all_stats else run_compartment_da(cells, min_total = m)$all_stats
    dplyr::mutate(stats, test = "proportions (diffcyt)", cells = cells, min_cells = m)
  }))
}))

check_density <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(threshold_check_classes, function(cells) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(c(0, threshold_check_min_cells), function(m)
    dplyr::mutate(density_tests(cells, min_total = m), test = "densities (glm.nb)", min_cells = m)))
}))

threshold_check <- dplyr::bind_rows(check_diffcyt[, check_columns], check_density[, check_columns]) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pair = paste(group1, group2, sep = "-"),
                call = dplyr::case_when(is.na(p_adj)        ~ "NA",
                                        p_adj >= alpha_check ~ "ns",
                                        logFC > 0            ~ "up",
                                        TRUE                 ~ "down")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(test, cells, cluster_name, pair) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(changed = any(call != call[min_cells == 0])) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

save_table(threshold_check, "threshold_check_long.csv", "threshold_check")

# one row per test x cluster x pair: samples, log2FC, adj. p and call per threshold
threshold_summary <- threshold_check %>%
  dplyr::select(test, cells, cluster_name, pair, min_cells, n_samples, logFC, p_adj, call, changed) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = min_cells, values_from = c(n_samples, logFC, p_adj, call),
                     names_glue = "{.value}_min{min_cells}")

save_table(threshold_summary, "threshold_check_summary.csv", "threshold_check")

cat(sum(threshold_summary$changed), "of", nrow(threshold_summary),
    "tests change their call with a minimum of", paste(threshold_check_min_cells, collapse = " or "), "cells\n")
knitr::kable(dplyr::filter(threshold_summary, changed), digits = 3,
             caption = "Tests whose call changes with the threshold")
```

```{r threshold-check-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
                  aes(x = cluster_name, y = logFC, color = factor(min_cells),

  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey60") +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), stroke = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(test ~ pair) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 16, `FALSE` = 1), na.value = 4,
                     labels = c(`TRUE` = paste0("adj. p < ", alpha_check),
                                `FALSE` = paste0("adj. p >= ", alpha_check)),
                     name = NULL) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = "min. cells\nper compartment") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "log2 fold change (second vs. first compartment)",
```
